reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our direct message: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

That number comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 20 Aug 2025 they posted that the account was going to 180 seats under Amendment No. 1, signed the day before. A few minutes later they corrected it: "It's 185, not 180."

I couldn't find the amendment itself among the files I can see, so I couldn't check the number against the signed document. I suggested Dana check the signed copy they sent June Osei-Lark before the number goes into the QBR deck.

A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and Dana owns the account, so no approval was needed.
